import sys

def main():
    discard_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    data_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')

    max_length_found = 0
    total_tokens_count = 0
    current_pos = 0
    last_pos = 0

    while current_pos < data_line.rfind(')'):
        start_paren = data_line.find('(', current_pos)
        end_paren = data_line.find(')', start_paren)
        segment = data_line[last_pos:start_paren]
        for token in segment.split('_'):
            if len(token) > max_length_found:
                max_length_found = len(token)
        inside_content = data_line[start_paren + 1:end_paren]
        for token in inside_content.split('_'):
            if token:
                total_tokens_count += 1
        last_pos = end_paren + 1
        current_pos = end_paren

    remaining_part = data_line[last_pos:]
    for token in remaining_part.split('_'):
        if len(token) > max_length_found:
            max_length_found = len(token)

    print(f"{max_length_found} {total_tokens_count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
